Hirslanden is Switzerland’s largest private hospital group, comprising 17 hospitals across the country, from Lake Constance to Lake Geneva. With over 300 medical centres and institutes, and more than 3,000 doctors, Hirslanden offers a comprehensive range of medical specialties and services, ensuring high-quality, patient-centred care.

Konstanz District Health Network ( Gesundheitsverbund Landkreis Konstanz, GLKN) is the largest healthcare provider in the western Lake Constance region of Germany. The network includes Klinikum Konstanz GmbH and Hegau-Bodensee-Klinikum Singen GmbH, operating over 1,200 beds and offering a comprehensive range of medical services. GLKN provides specialised healthcare across multiple disciplines, with a commitment to high-quality patient care, clinical expertise and medical research.

Lewisham and Greenwich NHS Trust is a community-focused healthcare provider serving over one million residents across the London boroughs of Lewisham, Greenwich, and Bexley. Operating Queen Elizabeth Hospital in Woolwich, University Hospital Lewisham, and multiple community settings, the Trust offers comprehensive services, including emergency and planned care, with a commitment to high-quality patient care, colleague support, and impactful community partnerships.

Swedish Hospital, part of NorthShore University HealthSystem, is a 289-bed award-winning hospital on Chicago’s North Side, offering advanced care in over 50 specialties, including women’s health and stroke care. Located in one of America’s most diverse areas, it embodies multiculturalism, with staff fluent in over 40 languages.

Limassol General Hospital, the largest in the district and second-largest in the State Health Services Organisation, operates with 329 beds, 6 operating rooms, and over 800 healthcare professionals. It offers specialised services, including the district’s only Haematology and Nephrology Clinics, advanced imaging technologies, and unique facilities like the Natural Childbirth Room and specialised Orthopaedic and Urology Clinics.

Paphos General Hospital, part of the State Health Services Organization, serves the Paphos district with 127 beds, 3 operating rooms, and over 380 healthcare professionals. It provides primary and specialised care, including a Diving Medicine Department, Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy Unit, and a soon-to-open state-of-the-art Dialysis Unit.

network.stated_total_quote: Τα μέλη του προσωπικού που ενδιαφέρονται για κινητικότητα διδασκαλίας σε ένα από τα πανεπιστήμια εταίρους που βρίσκονται στην Ευρώπη θα πρέπει να ψάξουν στη λίστα των Πανεπιστημίων με τα οποία το UNIC έχει συνάψει διμερή συμφωνία. Επί του παρόντος, το UNIC συνεργάζεται με 27 διαφορετικές ευρωπαϊκές χώρες και έχει πέραν από 300 διμερείς συμφωνίες με διαφορετικά ιδρύματα τριτοβάθμιας εκπαίδευσης για ακαδημαϊκές ανταλλαγές.
